people.name: Admah
people.line: One of the cities destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Gaza
people.line: Philistine city; Samson's exploits; Philip's ministry

people.name: Gerar
people.line: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech

people.name: Gomorrah
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God along with Sodom.

people.name: Lasha
people.line: A place marking Canaanite territory; a stop in Israel's journey

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

people.name: Zeboiim
people.line: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom

translations.web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
translations.bsb: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
translations.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
translations.asv: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.
